messages.subject: Project Beacon - completion funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Gavin,

Draft completion funds flow attached for sign-off ahead of Friday's completion. Sources: GBP18.24m equity from Crestview funds and GBP33m senior debt from Sterling. Applications: GBP43.5m completion payment, GBP2m retention, GBP4.5m refinancing of existing debt, SDRT GBP237,500, fees. It balances to nil.

Please confirm the equity is positioned to hit our client account by Thursday close.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0815
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
